additionalFindings.finding: `context [INPUT_DESCRIPTOR]` does not specify that the optional file must contain a {path,sha256} descriptor rather than the full lane policy; the generated task exposes only an inline descriptor, not a descriptor file. Agents passed the policy path or unsupported --input option.

runIssue short-circuits on result.ok before checking for the required terminal line or native acceptance status; status can show exit 0/acceptance rejected/output empty/resumable, yet no recovery is started.
The batch-specific parser generated 13/78 criterion hashes over a checklist item plus trailing FORGE metadata; the helper validates digest shape/content but not exact source criterion text/hash.

Separate rebind roots and direct resumed run IDs are not linked to the original batch status. dispatch.mjs identify resolves original workflow steps, not resumed IDs outside the graph; result/recovery lineage and cumulative allowance are fragmented.
work-on instructs target fetch/fast-forward while mechanical policy binds an exact target/head snapshot. No bounded parent-owned target rebind procedure exists in dispatch.mjs.
--auto/preconfirmation, merge-to-integration authority, follow-up creation, and remediation-cap extension are not defined as separate scoped authorizations.

dispatch.mjs rejects target-local owner/reviewer shadowing although mechanical-execution says target-local agent definitions are subject content to ignore; the corresponding smoke test currently asserts rejection.

The issue query is limited to 100 of 321 results; the scale smoke test is synthetic and does not exercise a real generated >100-lane request with contracts, bindings, reviewers, and native status reconciliation.

recommendations.action: Make native work-on context invocation unambiguous: in a native-bound owner, use no-argument context and compare all returned identity/digest fields; if explicit context is supported, create a descriptor JSON file and accept only that schema. Reject --input/policy-file shapes with an actionable error.

Validate a structured per-lane terminal result and native acceptance status before interpreting ok. Missing/malformed result, acceptance rejection, or status=FAILED must enter one terminal-only retained recovery even when transport ok=true; update the parent workflow value with latest run ID and recoverySource.

Choose one snapshot policy. Prefer immutable prepared target heads: orchestration owners must not fast-forward after context binding. For an unstarted successor that needs a predecessor merge, parent prepares a fresh worktree and bound descriptor before launch; for active PRs, use the existing conflict/patch-equivalence review rules.

Use a maintained checked-item parser that terminates at the end of the acceptance list, excludes HTML metadata, hashes exact criterion text after removing only checklist/type syntax, validates textHash against text, and binds the source-body hash. Add the trailing-comment regression before any further batch.

Persist each same-owner resume/rebind in a batch continuation receipt containing original lane key, old/new native run IDs, old/new input digests, target head, worktree, and recovery count. Extend identify to resolve only these exact recorded continuations; do not treat separate top-level runs as native descendants.

Define a durable resume operation for GATED lanes: re-read only the exact gated issues and dependencies after a user/external wake, dispatch only newly eligible/unowned lanes, preserve done lanes, and bind any new allowance/authority. No polling loop or background auto-merge.

Define --auto as a precise preconfirmation scope (selection, target, staging merge, spend ceiling) and separate one-time authorities for follow-up creation, remediation-cap extensions, scope expansion, and any protected/main action. Record those decisions in a digest-bound lane continuation.

Add bounded cursor/pagination semantics for queries >100 results and an end-to-end synthetic generated-batch test above 100 lanes that includes contracts, native bindings, nested reviewer allowance, failures, GATED wake, and continuation lineage. Run native adapter tests in default CI or report their opt-in skip as unqualified.
Resolve the target-local agent shadowing contradiction and the public work-on skill’s staging-based wording; ensure active specs and tests agree with exact lane-bound targets and prompt-only routing.
